about: St. John's step 7c: the MapMaker steps, in order, as the step's Playwright driver replayed them on maps/st_johns.json (PLAN_2026-11-12.md, 4l). Each step is one thing a person does in MapMaker: 'option' = select the placement (the Outliner's search, a click on its row) and choose in the set piece inspector's Options; 'delete' = select and Delete; 'place' = the Set pieces tab, R to turn, the level buttons, a click on the cell, then its Options; 'move' = the inspector's X / Height / Z. Cells are x, y on the grid (8 m), level 0 = the ground floor. Ids are the map's own as of main at 3c9eda88; a placement made by an earlier step has a new id each run.
